n: Hủ Tiếu Bò Viên 153 Vĩnh Viễn
address: 153 Vĩnh Viễn, Ward 4, District 10, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A ~1965 institution called one of Saigon's oldest beef-meatball noodle shops; hand-ground beef balls made fresh daily over an 8-hour beef-bone broth, a tight three-dish menu served afternoon to late night.
dish: hủ tiếu bò viên (beef-meatball rice-noodle soup)

n: Cà Phê Vợt Hẻm 330 Phan Đình Phùng
address: 330/2 Phan Đình Phùng, Ward 1, Phú Nhuận, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A French-era cloth-filter (cà phê vợt) coffee cart at the mouth of alley 330, run by octogenarians ông Ba and bà Ba; open around the clock, it has closed only once in over 60 years — Phú Nhuận's answer to Cheo Leo.

address: Phan Xích Long (Phan Đăng Lưu to Vạn Kiếp), Ward 2, Phú Nhuận, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Phú Nhuận's official food street (launched Jan 2024): a 1.5km strip of 200+ eateries from Phan Đăng Lưu to Vạn Kiếp — hotpot, seafood, Thai, chè and café rows — one of the city's busiest night-dining destinations.
dish: street-food strip — hotpot, seafood, snacks, chè, cafés

address: 66/5 Lê Đại Hành, Ward 7, District 11, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A 70-plus-year Cantonese noodle house tucked in a Ward 7 alley (locals call it 'hẻm Tư Ky'), now in its third generation; the draw is hand-pulled mì made with duck egg and lye water, served as mì vịt tiềm and hoành thánh.
dish: mì tươi kéo sợi / mì vịt tiềm (hand-pulled Cantonese egg noodles)

address: 8 Hoàng Hoa Thám, Ward 7, Bình Thạnh, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A MICHELIN Bib Gourmand sticky-rice bar (opened 2021) — the only xôi specialist on the HCMC Bib list; signature xôi phá lấu trứng non tops sticky rice with braised offal, quail eggs and fried shallots, served with soup and kimchi.
dish: xôi phá lấu trứng non (sticky rice with braised offal & quail egg)

address: 52 Nguyễn Công Trứ, Ward 19, Bình Thạnh, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A 2026 MICHELIN Bib Gourmand phở shop in Bình Thạnh known for phở bắp hoa with medium-rare beef — and a viral 'phở tine' that plates beef-noodle broth with french fries and cheese.

address: 57/21A Hồ Thị Kỷ, Ward 1, District 10, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A 50-plus-year Cambodian chè stall in the Hồ Thị Kỷ alley, run by Khmer-Vietnamese Cô Có (inherited from her mother); num-flan bí đỏ, palm-sugar coconut and sticky-rice Khmer sweets from ~7am, roughly 10–25k a bowl.
